The '''Serenno flying droid''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] present at [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Dooku's palace/Legends|castle]] on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] during the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tournament on Serenno/Legends|tournament]] there. It was used by [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]] to attack [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]], who was really the persona [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was disguised in.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Serenno_flying_droid.jpg|thumb|224px|Concept design of the droid]]
The asset for the droid in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]] episode "[[The Box]]" is taken from that of the Separatist probe droid in "[[Defenders of Peace]]."''
